LanguageData.MX_MingyuanSkill.label: Mingyuan
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash.label: <color=#FFB25C>Ascendant Flame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash.descripti: Dash up to 150 cells in a chosen direction. Design target: invulnerable wall-piercing dash, minor path damage, knockback, stun, 100 Life Burn layers to enemies, and 30 Life Burn layers to Mingyuan. Warmup 0 seconds, cooldown 3 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion.label: <color=#FFD37A>Instant Combustion</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion.descriptio: Release a flash centered on Mingyuan. Design target: burn eyes and brain of enemies within 30 cells for 10 damage each, double their Life Burn layers, and stun for 12 seconds. Warmup 3 seconds, cooldown 18 hours.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillar.label: <color=#FF7A45>Burning Pillar</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillar.description: Raise a pillar of flame at a target location. Design target: radius 15, lasts 4 hours, hits 4 times per second for 400 damage and 100 Life Burn layers per hit; buildings and animals are destroyed. Range 50, warmup 5 seconds, cooldown 24 hours.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurn.label: <color=#C95CFF>Time Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurn.description: Stop a selected unit's ticks for 24 hours. Design target: damage during the stop applies directly to the body and age is set to 0; buildings are disassembled into materials. Warmup 8 seconds, cooldown 48 hours.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf.label: <color=#FF5C3A>Ashes of Self</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf.description: Spend blood or shield energy to apply 100 Self Burn layers and create a 5x5 burning field. Design target: the field deals damage every 0.5 seconds, stacks burn, and each Self Burn layer increases damage, speed, attack speed, work speed, and shield regeneration. Warmup 0.5 seconds, cooldown 15 seconds.
